text:
## ఉచిత ఇసుక అంటూ గొప్పలు చెప్పి, ఇప్పుడు టెండర్ నోటిఫికేషన్లు ఇవ్వడం.. ఎవరికి దోచిపెట్టడానికి?
DISTRICT LEVEL SAND COMMITTEE COLLECTORATE, PALNADI
Short Notice Inviting Bids
Looking at Sand as the designated Stock pits in Palnadi District and other places and
Bid Notice No. 532/DLSC/07/2024.

THE DISTRICT LEVEL SAND CO-ORDINATOR,
PALNADI, DISTT., BEHOVES FOR THE COLLECTION OF BID DRAFTS FROM INTERESTED AGENTS/
FOR MANUFACTURED STOCK PITS IN PALNADI DISTRICT AND OTHER PLACES AS ALSO SPECIFIED IN SCHEDULE NO:-18 TO THIS NOTICE BY INVITING BOIDS ON SHORT & MEDIUM TERM BASIS AT THEIR OWN RISK WHEREAS THEY ARE LIABLE TO PAY ALL COSTS INCLUDING TRANSPORTATION OF SUCH Manufatured stock yaks to Collector's Vehicles for transportation of such stocked yards including a ramp and exit main road within one day from date of receipt by them on short term basis only with their own risk and liability towards any loss or damage caused thereby during transit etc. The successful bidder shall be responsible also if he fails so do due to his negligence while loading out sand along side roads leading up to these manufatured stocks which are located outside district limits.		 BID DATE: 09-06-2024
DATE OF OPENING OF TENDERS:
09-06-2024
TIME OF CLOSURE OF TENDERS: 12:00 PM
PLACE: Narsapurapalle, Distt. Palnadu
Sl.
